newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas trades only once as busy spell ends.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas trades only once as busy spell ends.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw only a single deal done on Wednesday, in a reversal after a string of busy days.
One 25-lot deal was done in March at 14.10 pence a therm, down by 0.20 pence on Tuesday's settlement price, but otherwise the screen was blank.
The slow day followed busy sessions on Tuesday, with 325 lots done, Monday with 250 lots, and last week when a total of 1475 lots were traded.

Although little trade was done, levels were generally lower, especially in the winter. All winter contracts from October through to March were offered at or below the settlement price of the previous day.
And bid/offer spreads were wide in many periods. Front month August ended bid at 9.25 pence and offered at 9.70 pence, while September closed in a wider range of 9.25/9.85 pence.
